messages:
maya: kicking off LON1 provisioning acceptance run. posting checklist and quick smoke run.
chris: thanks. can we confirm GPU types? should be A10G x16 per rack.
frances: correct. inventory shows 8 nodes in pool-cc-lon1, labels: region=lon1,gpu=rtx-a10
raj: quick note — network team flagged jumbo frames not set on leaf-02 yet.
maya: put that on the checklist: MTU 9000 on all host NICs and TORs.
chris: smoke items I want: kube nodes Ready, nvidia drivers loaded, nv_peer_mem, RDMA if applicable, iptables off for CNI, kube-proxy mode=ipvs.
maya: agreed. also check /health endpoints and trace sampling to ensure telemetry flows.
frances: command snippets:
```
kubectl get nodes -l region=lon1 -o wide
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
ssh node-01 sudo nvidia-smi -q | head -n 20
curl -s http://10.10.2.5:8080/health
```
raj: I'll run MTU check across leafs:
```
# on leaf
ip link show eth1
ping -M do -s 8972 10.10.2.1
```
maya: SLO gates to confirm before handoff:
- control-plane p95 scheduling latency < 200ms
- inference p95 token latency for 32-token request < 50ms (cold) and < 20ms (warm)
- pod OOMs = 0 for 1h stress
- GPU util across pool avg < 70% during baseline test
chris: also cost/ops notes: estimated sustained qps 40 with batch=8 => ~2.2 GPUs per 1k qps, ballpark cost $0.85/hr per GPU after discounts. rough calc attached in google sheet: https://short.link/ri-lon1-cost
frances: running basic smoke now, will paste logs.
frances: node-03 shows driver mismatch, kernel module missing. log:
```
Mar 18 09:12:03 node-03 kernel: nvidia: module verification failed
```
maya: assign to raj for remediation. raj: on it, will reprovision node-03 with correct driver bundle.
raj: reprovision done, `sudo modprobe nvidia` succeeds. nvidia-smi output shows 8GB free on all cards.
frances: services up: inference-deployment x3/3, model-cache healthy, kv-cache warm.
maya: autoscale smoke: send 200 concurrent small requests, expect scale-up to 12 pods within 90s.
chris: load script:
```
hey -n 20000 -c 200 http://inference.lon1.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
frances: running load — current scale 3 -> 9 in 45s -> 12 in 82s. p95 latency steady at 27ms.
maya: good. rolling upgrade policy check: canary deploy works, automatic rollback on 5xxs enabled.
chris: finalize the runbook items for handoff:
- ticket with remediation steps for node replacement
- runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/infrarunbooks/lon1-acceptance
- oncall pager assigned: @maya
- postmortem template ready if we breach SLOs during next 24h
maya: I've added runbook entries and tagged finance for cost approval.
frances: quick QA: GPU PCIe lanes check done: all nodes show x16 for GPUs.
raj: network MTU fixed on leaf-02, re-tested, no packet drops.
maya: final checklist status:
- nodes ready ✅
- drivers ✅
- nv_peer_mem ✅
- MTU ✅
- RDMA N/A (no InfiniBand) ✅
- CNI healthy ✅
- autoscale ✅
- tracing/metrics ✅
- cost estimate pending finance sign-off 🔜
chris: thumbs up. @sre-bot please create acceptance flag for lon1 in prod-control-plane.
sre-bot: acceptance flag created: `region:lon1` -> state: staging-accepted by maya at 2026-03-18T09:31:00Z
maya: handing off to oncall for 24h monitoring. please escalate to eng-oncall if p95 token latency > 60ms for 3 consecutive 5min windows.
raj: added alert: inference.lon1.p95 > 60ms for 15m -> page oncall.
frances: leaving a note — next steps: run full perf regression with 1k concurrent users tomorrow.
maya: thanks team. I'll post the final sign-off in the morning after 24h. :thumbsup:
